heading: Exemptions and equivalents

tree.heading: Exemptions.—
tree.text: If the Secretary considers that recreational vessel safety will not be adversely affected, the Secretary may issue an exemption from this chapter or a regulation prescribed under this chapter.

tree.heading: Equivalents.—
tree.text: The Secretary may accept a substitution for associated equipment performance or other safety standards for a recreational vessel if the substitution provides an equivalent level of safety.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 430546:1458 Section 4305 permits the Secretary to grant appropriate exemptions from the requirements of this chapter when recreational vessel safety will not be adversely affected.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2021—Pub. L. 116–283 substituted “Exemptions and equivalents” for “Exemptions” in section catchline, designated existing provisions as subsec. (a) and inserted heading, and added subsec. (b).
